inputs.text: Vertical medium shot in the same apartment study. The same adult Chinese woman age 28 sits safely at the wooden desk. One smartphone lies face-down and inactive on the desk, showing only its matte rear shell and camera module. Her hands are lowering from her face after a relieved breath and she looks toward camera with calm gratitude. Same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush stop-motion film, soft textile fibers, gently warm reassuring light, clean upper-third negative space. Exactly one face-down phone, no visible screen, no interface, no generated text.
